record.question:
A politician strongly recommends a candidate for appointment in a temporary government post under
       your supervision. The candidate is underqualified and others in the list are better suited. What should
       you do?
options: Evaluate all candidates on merit and document the process transparently.
Appoint the recommended candidate to avoid political conflict.
Request the politician to send a better candidate.
